en.abdullah-al-shahin: (58) Abdul Wahid bin Abdullah narrated from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Rabah from Ahmad bin Ali al-Himyari from al-Hasan bin Ayyoob from Abdul Kareem bin Amr al-Khath’ami from someone that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:
“Al-Qa’im will appear after when twelve men will have agreed upon that they have seen him but they will be considered as liars.”
